name: Leanstral 1.5 119B-A6B

lineage.how_derived: updated Lean 4 specialist built as part of the Mistral Small 4 family

purpose: Open-source code agent for Lean 4, the proof assistant used for complex mathematical objects (perfectoid spaces) and software specifications (properties of Rust fragments); built to be performant and cost-effective compared with closed alternatives (card).

Lean 4.evidence: purpose-built Lean 4 agent; benchmark figure is an image on the card, not read

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Repo has no LICENSE file; card tag apache-2.0. Text read: standard Apache License 2.0 text, identical to https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt (read 2026-11-19).

architecture.kind: MoE with multi-head latent attention (Mistral Small 4 family), multimodal input
architecture.attention: MLA (q_lora_rank 1024, kv_lora_rank 256, 32 heads), YaRN to 1,048,576 positions in params.json
architecture.why_this_design: Card: built on the Mistral Small 4 family to combine multimodal capabilities with an efficient MoE architecture, making it 'both performant and cost-effective'; recommended context is 200K or less.

variants.notes: 10,544 downloads, created 2026-07-04; several other community GGUF, NVFP4 and MLX builds exist; sizes not collected

mac-64gb-plus.notes: needs 96 GB or more for headroom

other: vLLM >= 0.24.0 with mistral_common >= 1.11.5 (card: --tool-call-parser mistral, --reasoning-parser mistral, TP 4 example)
Mistral API (free plan, Labs models opt-in)
engine_support.notes: Tool requirements: designed for Mistral Vibe (vibe --agent lean after /leanstall) and recommended with lean-lsp-mcp so the agent talks to the Lean language server; local use through a vLLM server configured in ~/.vibe/agents/lean.toml (temperature 1.0, thinking high, auto-compact at 168000 tokens, bash timeout 1200 s). Card advises using the Mistral API if local serving is subpar. Community GGUFs exist; llama.cpp quality for this model is unchecked.

strengths: Only open model on record built specifically for Lean 4 proving and verification
weaknesses: Benchmark comparison is an image on the card, no numbers read
best_for: Lean 4 proof and verification work with lean-lsp-mcp
soft.maturity: Mistral AI; update of Leanstral-2603 (445 downloads of the original repo, 10.5K of one GGUF).

tona_fit.reason: Niche specialist: valuable only for users who write Lean 4; Apache-2.0 (text read) and capable on paper, but 119B-A6.5B needs a large RAM class and the agent expects the Vibe CLI plus lean-lsp-mcp. Not a general worker.
blockers: no MLA/Mistral Small 4 module in Tona

open_questions: Quality of community GGUFs against the FP8 original on Lean tasks
Whether a smaller Lean model exists
